name: Data.paramsCorrespond_grid
summary: At each place: the gaps (from `Data.hasGap_gridParam`, monotone in the bound), and the matching of the indices of the two nodes, entry by entry, by integer arithmetic.

steps.claim: For each infinite place τ, the four conditions: the two parameters have gaps (`Data.hasGap_gridParam`, negated when d is true, relaxed by the size bounds `Data.card_gridIndex_le`), and every index of one node is matched to one of the other (base indices to base indices, block entries to block entries or the new block) with the required relation of parameters, by integer arithmetic with the parity of the sizes (`Data.card_gridIndex_mod_two`).
steps.lean:
(negIf d (D.gridParam z o i' j')) (D.gridSigns z o i j) (D.gridSigns z o i' j') := fun τ ↦ by
  refine ⟨?_, .neg ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  iterate 2 exact .mono (d.rec id .neg (D.hasGap_gridParam τ _ _ _ _ (by lia))) (by
    grw [card_gridIndex_le, card_gridIndex_le] <;> first | lia | use D.le_of_hasLogBound)
  all_goals cases d <;> cases e <;> simp_rw [reindex_equiv D.gridBlockEquiv.symm] <;> use Sum.rec
              (Sum.rec (.inl ⟨.inl <| .inl ·, ?_⟩) fun (l, y) ↦ (em _).imp (⟨.inl <| .inr
    ⟨⟨l, ·⟩, y⟩, ?_⟩) ?_) (fun (l, y) ↦ (em _).imp (⟨.inr ⟨⟨l, ·⟩, y⟩, ?_⟩) ?_) <;> push_cast
    [typevec, apply_ite Units.val] <;> grind -linarith [D.card_gridIndex_mod_two z i j]
